class.name: LibMaszynaUnits
class.brief_description: Unit conversion factors shared by the C++ code and GDScript.
class.description: Constants only, read as [code]LibMaszynaUnits.SECONDS_PER_MINUTE[/code]. Every factor is a whole number, bound as an [int]; dividing an [int] by one truncates, so an integer value is converted with [code]float()[/code] first.

constants.constant: Seconds in a minute; also converts revolutions per minute to revolutions per second, the unit the simulation keeps engine speed in.
Minutes in an hour; the time of day is kept in hours.
Hours in a day; the time of day wraps at it.
Microseconds in a second, the unit of [method Time.get_ticks_usec].
Newtons in a kilonewton; the vehicle data gives forces in kN.
Kilograms in a tonne; the vehicle data gives masses in tonnes.
Kilopascals in a bar; a pressure in bar on an area in m² gives a force in kN after this factor.
Joules in a kilowatt-hour, the unit of the energy meter.
